description: This file contains a unit test class for testing the ViewJson class within the SuiteCRM application's MVC view layer. It specifically tests instantiation and a property of the ViewJson object.

classes.name: ViewJsonTest
classes.description: A unit test class for verifying the behavior of the ViewJson class in the SuiteCRM framework.
